My name is what it is, and I farm this small rice plot here in the South East. The land is my own, thank God, and rice needs plenty water so I plant in the lowland area where the rain collects — no pump, no irrigation, I depend on the rains and the fadama. I will buy some NPK and urea if the agro-dealer has it at a fair price, because rice without fertilizer gives very poor yield on this our tired soil. I use improved seed when I can get it from the ADP, and me and my wife and the children will do most of the work, but for transplanting and harvesting I must hire some hands because the work is too much for one family.
